scope: the routable ROS domains this runtime may subscribe to for camera imagery
note: The sheppy deployment publishes its camera streams on the host network in ROS domain 0 by design (rammp-deployments december_2026 manifest, network_mode: host). Subscribing to those streams from this runtime does not confine them; it only reads what the deployment already puts on the wire.
reason: sheppy wrist_camera and scene_camera nodes publish on ROS_DOMAIN_ID=0 over network_mode: host; the streams are not loopback-confined by the deployment
